summary: Hitek Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held July 29, 2026. Shareholders representing 93.08% of votes were present. They approved re-appointment of five directors, ratification of auditor Wei, Wei Co., LLP, subdivision of Class A shares 1:3,750 (from 800,000 to 3,000,000,000 shares), authorization for future consolidations up to 1-for-6,000, name change to Biddance AI Systems, Inc., and continuation from Cayman Islands to BVI. These are routine governance and capital-structure proposals, not a special situation.
